Great post OP. I don't know how much truth in is in these apocryphal tales about Headley. Apparently, he had tactic of tacking spinners by hammering the ball as hard as he could straight down at them early in their spells. The goal was to sting and or worse hurt their bowling fingers. Other tactic was to target fielding positions where the opposition's bowlers were stationed. The goal was to make them run as much as possible and tire them early.
